title: CR-BRK-020 — Reverse WO invoice with WO Delete but a payment exists — validation
preconds: WO V/E/D \u2713 | See Financial \u2713 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. On a WO that has a payment, attempt reverse invoice.
expected:
WO Delete permits reverse invoice ONLY when validation criteria are met, e.g., no payments made (§1a Delete). With a payment present, reversal must be blocked; WO Delete is 'not enough to delete payments.'

Risk / Rationale: Reversal proceeds despite an existing payment, or it attempts to delete the payment (which WO Delete must not allow).
Spec Ref: §1a WO Delete
